value.name: retrieves hidden photograph
value.description: Asha opens the glovebox and takes out a photo of her mother that she had hidden there months earlier.
evidence: she leaned across the briefcase and opened the glovebox, and from beneath the registration and a folded map she drew out the small photo she had put there months ago and never looked at on purpose: her mother on the back steps of the Bryn Mawr house the summer before the diagnosis

value.name: displays mother photo on dashboard
value.description: She props the photograph against the speedometer so it stays in view as she drives.
evidence: She propped it against the base of the speedometer where the dashboard light caught it.
When the light changed she drove on with the picture in the corner of her vision

value.name: drives to Bryn Mawr exit
value.description: Asha continues driving and takes the exit for Bryn Mawr.
evidence: When the light changed she drove on with the picture in the corner of her vision, and the exit for Bryn Mawr came up and she took it.

value.name: arrives at group home
value.description: Asha reaches the group home and pulls into the small lot beside staff vehicles.
evidence: The group home sat back from the road behind a low hedge, its porch light burning yellow against the wet asphalt of the small lot.
Asha pulled in past a staff sedan and a minivan with a wheelchair decal

value.name: shuts off car and lingers
value.description: She kills the engine and hesitates in the car as the warmth fades and the cold returns.
evidence: killed the engine, and let the dashboard lights fade until only the propped photograph caught any glow.
Her hands stayed on the wheel longer than she meant them to, tightening until the knuckles went pale, and she registered the cold creeping back into the car through the windshield.

value.name: hides photo in coat pocket
value.description: Before getting out, Asha turns the photograph face-down and puts it in her coat pocket so it will not be left alone in the car.
evidence: When she finally let go, she folded the photo face-down into her coat pocket before she opened the door, because she did not want to leave her mother's summer face alone in an empty car at midnight.

value.name: gets out carrying briefcase
value.description: Asha exits the car with the briefcase in hand, preparing to go inside.
evidence: Asha got out of the car with the briefcase in her hand
